canonical_clean_row_order.clean_position: Zero-based position in the above canonical clean row order.
canonical_clean_row_order.definition: All K79-retained development rows sorted by (day_id ASC, original_zero_based_row_index ASC).

membership_storage.chronological_membership: derived exactly from day_id; no redundant full bitset required.
membership_storage.chronological_rebalanced_selected_benign: bit-packed boolean vector length 14,412,403; 1 means benign row retained in CHRONOLOGICAL_REBALANCED training.
membership_storage.integrity: Every membership bitset receives SHA256 and exact population-count assertions before Git freeze.
membership_storage.random_rebalanced_selected_benign: bit-packed boolean vector length 14,412,403; 1 means benign row retained in RANDOM_REBALANCED training.
membership_storage.random_training: logical complement of random_validation over clean universe; not redundantly stored.
membership_storage.random_validation: bit-packed boolean vector length 14,412,403; 1 means RANDOM validation.

natural.training_membership: all rows assigned to that split's training partition
natural.validation_membership: all rows assigned to that split's validation partition

next_authorized_step: Stage22R-1B1 — generate and freeze RANDOM, CHRONOLOGICAL, NATURAL and REBALANCED development memberships according to these exact semantics.

random_split.input: clean_position integers in canonical clean row order
random_split.membership_post_sort: After sklearn returns memberships, each membership is sorted ascending by clean_position solely for storage. Sorting does not alter membership.

rebalanced.benign_candidate_order: Ascending clean_position among benign rows belonging to the relevant training partition.
rebalanced.fail_closed_rule: If available benign training rows are fewer than target_benign_count, abort without oversampling.
rebalanced.operator: For EACH split independently instantiate numpy.random.RandomState(42), call permutation() on the ascending benign training clean_position array, and retain the first target_benign_count positions.
rebalanced.selected_membership_post_sort: Selected benign clean_positions are sorted ascending after selection solely for storage.
